narrative: The first line still there. Under it, a new line in a smaller hand. The smear of the last try is at the edge. No face. The two plain lines. He has not written a cup, a vial, or a drink. The bundle is still a red knot at the side. No face. The stylus lifted. The page is those two lines and nothing under them. One candle. No face.
